name: pairwatch
description: Learn while Claude works: an animated pane, or a page of its own on this machine, that shows and explains in plain language what the session is doing and why.

narratorModel.title: Narration model
narratorModel.description: Model that writes the live narration, a choice between the listed options: haiku (fast and cheap) or sonnet.

viewer.title: Viewer page
viewer.description: Serve Pairwatch's own page on this machine (for editors that don't draw mod panes, such as the VS Code chat panel)

viewerPort.title: Viewer port
viewerPort.description: The local port Pairwatch's page is served on (127.0.0.1 only).
